objective: Preallocate FBTree leaf and inner node buffers from the fixed FANOUT bound.

tasks.title: Preallocate FBTree node slots
tasks.result: FBTree leaf and inner node construction now preallocates slot buffers from the fixed FANOUT bound.

notes: Cargo/linker verification used an E: workspace temp directory because the default C:/TEMP drive was previously full.
The capacity bound comes from the FBTree FANOUT constant, not from a speculative iterator size hint.
The change preserves bulk-load order, leaf linking, inner feature rebuilds, get, and scan behavior.
